sections.title: The Intuitive Hook: The Prism Analogy
lecture_lines: Fourier Transform decomposes signals like a prism.
Complex signals are sums of simple sine waves.
Think of a smoothie's original ingredients.
animations: White light enters a triangular prism on the left. (Color: #FFFFFF)
The light splits into distinct colors within the prism. (Color: #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF)
The colors emerge from the prism in a spectrum. (Color: #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF)

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Periodic Oscillations
lecture_lines: Waves are defined by amplitude and frequency.
Multiple waves combine into complex shapes.
animations: A simple sine wave oscillates smoothly across the screen. (Color: #FFFF00)
Increase the oscillation frequency to show faster movement. (Color: #FFFF00)
Demonstrate the period duration as a static labeled bracket. (Color: #FF00FF)

sections.title: The Core Concept: Moving from Time to Frequency
lecture_lines: Integrals match signals to reference frequencies.
animations: A complex wave is shown as a combination of sine waves. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Isolate individual simple sine components from the complex wave. (Color: #00FFFF, #FF00FF)
Sum the components back into the original complex wave. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Rotate the perspective to reveal the frequency domain axis. (Color: #FF8800)
Map the component amplitudes onto the frequency domain axis. (Color: #FF8800)

sections.title: The Fourier Transform Integral: Decoding the Signature
lecture_lines: The transform multiplies signal by sine waves.
animations: Display the Fourier Transform integral formula prominently. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight the variable 't' shifting through time. (Color: #FFFF00)
Highlight the exponential complex component rotating. (Color: #00FF00)
Show the integration area accumulating value. (Color: #FF00FF)
The resulting frequency spike emerges from the integral. (Color: #FF8800)

sections.title: Application: The Digital World
lecture_lines: Fourier Transform powers modern digital tech.
animations: Visualize an audio waveform becoming digital samples. (Color: #00FFFF)
Show compression reducing the number of stored samples. (Color: #FF00FF)
Decompress to show the reconstructed wave shape. (Color: #00FFFF)
